title: Crew of Wellington LN281
memorial_details: Three-sectioned, brick wall with inset rectangular, black, slate tablet, all set within a triangular, gravelled surround. The dedication is incised in white, upper and lower-case letters. Three coloured crests (painted or possibly enamelled) - RAF top centre, 14 Squadron OTU lower left and Bomber Command lower right. An information board is mounted on the obverse of the wall.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THE BRAVE AIRMEN/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN THEIR AIRCRAFT/ WELLINGTON MK X LN281/ OF NO.14 O.T.U. RAF MARKET HARBOROUGH/ CRASHED NEAR THIS SITE ON 13TH AUGUST 1944/ (names)/ ALSO/ (name)/ WHO WAS THE ONLY SURVIVOR AND SUFFERED SERIOUS INJURIES/ IN FRIENDSHIP AND IN SERVICE/WE WILL REMEMBER THEM
